To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) a mutual information-based analysis shows that source-related features outperform filter-based features, and that the proposed features are particularly discriminative; (ii) an artificial neural network classifier trained on a large multi-condition database achieves a low equal error rate of 3% and outperforms the state-of-the-art by 3% absolute; and (iii) the proposed decision fusion strategy achieves a further improvement of 3% absolute over feature fusion.
